title: Fix flashlight gamepad toggle reliability
objective: Make the flashlight gamepad toggle in examples/flashlight/run.py reliable for normal Xbox controller button presses.
instructions: The current default toggle key Gamepad_FaceButton_Right maps to Xbox B; keep or clearly justify any change.
Investigate and fix why normal button presses can be missed; likely cause is polling WasInputKeyJustPressed only every idle_period_seconds.
Prefer edge detection using a key-down query plus previous state if SPEAR/Unreal exposes it through the same player controller path.
Keep pose capture behavior intact, but consider applying the same reliable edge pattern to capture-key if it uses the same gamepad polling issue.
expected_outputs: Explain Xbox button mapping and reliability fix.
Manual verification command and button to press.
definition_of_done: A normal Xbox B button press toggles the flashlight without needing an unusually long hold.
Existing Enter pose capture remains intact.
